task: PBI-2 Multi-Warehouse Inventory with Low-Stock Alerts
summary: Add multi-warehouse inventory to EverShop: warehouses/inventory/stock_alerts tables, per-warehouse inventory + reserve + alerts APIs, admin grid with color-coded low-stock indicators and bulk threshold updates, low-stock alert trigger, and knowledge-capture metric events.
inScope: knowledge-capture metric events: candidate_staged (threshold proposed), decision_knowledge (approve/reject), retrieval_success (alert history audit)
outOfScope: Deprecating or rewriting the existing catalog product_inventory table in this pass (keep both; migrate later)
Order-fulfillment warehouse-selection algorithm (per-warehouse API only; selection decided later)
External notification/email providers for stock alerts (alert_sent flag only)
.env access, production or customer data, protected-data bypass
Persisting rule/threshold contents as AgenticLab durable knowledge records
validation: npm run build passes (client + server bundles, GraphQL query bundles generated for new admin pages)
unit tests for inventory service, alert trigger, and reserve concurrency pass
POST /api/inventory/reserve succeeds with sufficient stock and fails with insufficient stock
admin grid renders per-warehouse columns with color-coded low-stock indicators
metrics file contains only allowlisted events with no rule/threshold/product data
stopConditions: plan contradicts current source (e.g. product_inventory structure differs from inspected state)
metrics leak threshold, product, customer, or warehouse contents
reserve endpoint can oversell stock under concurrency
migration would drop or corrupt existing product_inventory data
decisions: New dedicated inventory module (packages/evershop/src/modules/inventory) rather than extending catalog
Existing product_inventory table is kept untouched in this pass; new inventory table is additive
Reserve uses PostgreSQL advisory lock scoped to (product_id, warehouse_id) as the PBI specifies
Low-stock detection is crossing-based (quantity < min_threshold) and creates a stock_alert row
Knowledge-capture integration follows the PBI-1 pattern: narrow allowlisted writer, event + timestamp only, no payload
Admin UI follows the promotion module convention (grid + shared edit/new form folder)
Warehouse management (create/edit warehouses) is admin-only and gated by existing auth middleware
